reasonCode.text: Opportunity confidence 0.79 exceeded threshold 0.62 and all six hard gates passed

note.text: DECISION TRACE — place=known-significant (significance 0.88, caregiver-tagged); theta/alpha=1.61 (z=+1.8 vs personal baseline); agitation_index=0.24 (below 0.70 veto threshold); eligible content items=3; signal quality=0.82. Gates: agitation PASS, refractory PASS (last cue 71 min ago, minimum 45), quiet hours PASS, consent PASS, quality PASS, daily budget PASS (3 of 8 used). Fused confidence 0.79.

ARM SELECTION — contextual bandit, epsilon-greedy. Selected arm=photo (estimated value 0.71 over n=14 trials for THIS patient). Alternatives: voice 0.66 (n=9), ambient-audio 0.44 (n=6), scent 0.31 (n=4). Selection was exploitative, not exploratory. Learning is per-patient; these values are not pooled across patients.

CONTENT — content_id=synthetic-courtyard-1974, media_type=photo, curator=SYNTHETIC family caregiver, sensitivity=routine, no clinical sign-off required. Content involving a deceased person would have required clinical sign-off before entering the eligible pool.
DELIVERY — modality=AR overlay, latency 1.4 s from signal to display (target < 2 s p95). Single cue only; no modality stacking. Dismissible without interaction. Motion lockout check passed.

WHY A Procedure RESOURCE: this is an intervention performed on a patient with an intended therapeutic effect, delivered autonomously to a cognitively vulnerable person. It must appear in the record as something that happened TO them, and must be visible to audit. Modelling it as a lesser resource type would make it invisible. See docs/05-data-architecture.md.

coding.display: Patient response to memory anchoring cue

note.text: REWARD ASYMMETRY — recalled=+1.0, engaged-no-recall=+0.3, ignored=0.0, DISTRESSED=-2.0. The -2.0 against +1.0 encodes a clinical judgement: upsetting someone is worse than failing to help them. A symmetric reward would, under a noisy signal, drift the policy toward firing more often. This one drifts toward silence. See ADR-0008.
MISSING DATA HANDLING — the caregiver confirmation is recorded as absent, NOT imputed as success. Systems that impute missing feedback as positive learn to fire constantly.
